d:
Kendriy mantri aur lok janshakti parti (ramvilas) ke rashtriy adhyaksh chirag pasvan ne munbaee men chhath puja aur chhath giton par raj thakre ke rukh par palatvar kiya hai. unhonne kshetravad ki rajniti karne vale dalon ko ghera aur saph kaha ki vo kisi bhi tarah ki bantvare ki rajniti ka samarthan nahin karte.
